summary: Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a multi-year commercial sponsorship agreement with the National Football League in Mexico. The company becomes Official Betting Partner of the NFL in Mexico, an Official Partner of Super Bowl LXI in February 2027 and the NFL Mexico Game on November 22, 2026, plus Official Sports Betting Sponsor. No financial terms, equity stakes, prices, premiums, advisors or board recommendations were disclosed. This is a routine marketing and sponsorship contract, not a special situation; watch only for any related financing or guidance updates.
